cases.detail: Legacy Result grants remain behind RLS; canonical Payroll has no browser writes.
Canonical write RPCs remain service-only at the database boundary.
service_role retains the canonical server-action RPC path.
RC2I Manager has Result, Survey and Performance permissions.
RC2I Supervisor can verify Result but has no Payroll permission.
RC2I Payroll can calculate, approve and close Payroll and cannot write Result.
RC2I Viewer is read-only and receives only performance.view.
Payroll and B-Pay reconciliation views remain server-only.
Payroll mutation guards are installed; closed-row mutation passed negative runtime UAT.
Authenticated RC2I Manager updated zero Result and Worker rows under RLS.
